wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-004 wires the savegame write path via one src/vanilla facade (wireSavegameWrite.ts) re-exporting the read-only saveHeader (writeSaveGameHeader/readSaveGameHeader, version 109, fixed header size), coreSerialization (writeArchivedPlayers/Mobjs/World + read*, SAVEGAME_MOBJ_SIZE 154 / PLAYER_SIZE 280, THINKER_CLASS_END 0 / _MOBJ 1), and specialSerialization (writeArchivedSpecials/readArchivedSpecials, per-class special sizes + class tags). VANILLA_SAVEGAME_WRITE_INVARIANTS pins five rules (fixed header w/ version 109; fixed mobj/player record sizes; world sectors->lines->sides->thinkers order; thinker list terminated by CLASS_END 0; specials serialized by class with fixed sizes). The shared SAVEGAME_PLAYER_COUNT / SaveGamePlayerPresence names are surfaced from saveHeader only to avoid a TS duplicate-export. The focused test exercises a real writeSaveGameHeader/readSaveGameHeader round-trip + version-corruption rejection, the struct-size constants, the multi-line-tolerant ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax).
